title: rosa × centifolia bullata
intro: Rosa × centifolia bullata, commonly known as Bullata Centifolia, is a hybrid rose species known for its unique characteristics. As a medicinal plant, it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × centifolia bullata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. These constituents may also contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, such as digestive issues and skin problems.
